note: One timeline for the page (captions), the subtitles (.srt) and the mix (voice starts). Times in seconds.

hook.zh: 一年没了 130 万箱蜜蜂
hook.en: In one year, American beekeepers lost 1.3 million honey bee colonies.

caps.en: Nearly half of what they started with.
So, are America's bees running out?

caps.zh: 没有。|1 月 1 日的总数|{涨了 6%}
caps.en: No. By January, colonies were up 6%.

caps.zh: 因为养蜂人|一直在补：|{145 万箱}
caps.en: Because beekeepers kept rebuilding: almost 1.5 million new colonies.
They raise new ones, buy them whole, or give old ones a new queen.

caps.zh: 2025 年每个季度的|头号威胁：|{瓦螨}
caps.en: The top stressor, every quarter of 2025: varroa mites.

caps.zh: 2026 年初，|{超过五分之一}|的蜂群受害
caps.en: In early 2026, they affected more than one in five colonies.

caps.zh: 这一季最糟：|三个月没了|{16%}
caps.en: That quarter was the worst in six: 16% gone in three months.

caps.zh: 光加州|就没了|{22 万箱}
到 6 月，|又补了|{108 万箱}
caps.en: And still, by June, they had added over a million more.
